Resolves #19521

A dock commit that moves a tabs node across the root now keeps its tab container on screen. After `moveRetainedTabChrome`, the swap used to treat `host.items[shellIndex]` as the next shell and the old shell as outgoing, which only fits a tabs root that stays the root. Two changes fix it:

- **Un-nest:** a staged root that was a retained tab's placeholder now resolves to that tab. Collapsing a split to one of its tabs nodes therefore retires the old split instead of keeping it as the shell.
- **Nest:** an old shell the projection nested into the staged split is no longer the host's child, so nothing is outgoing. Splitting a tab root no longer hides its tab container. A swap flight that fails keeps the staged split, which holds it.

Evidence: L3 (local Chrome on the bare-consumer fixture's tab root, real reducer and refresh loop) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2). `DockTabRootCrossing.spec.mjs` runs in CI's components tier. No residual.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `DockTabRootCrossing.spec.mjs` › `splitting the tab root nests its tab container, visible beside the new one`: one shell fills the host, both tab containers are visible, and the root one keeps its id. The unit pin `nesting the tab root keeps its tab container, visible, inside the staged split` checks the same component: its parent is the split, it is not hidden, and it does not carry the retiring class. |
| AC-2 | `DockTabRootCrossing.spec.mjs` › `collapsing a split to one of its tabs nodes makes that tab container the only shell`: the host's only shell is that tab container, by id, filling the host. The unit pin `collapsing a split to one of its tabs nodes leaves that retained tab as the only shell` adds that the old split is destroyed and both panes are in the tab. |
| AC-3 | The same-root path is unchanged: `DockShellRetirement.spec.mjs`'s retained-root control (activate a tab: a shell is staged, the root is never marked) passes, and so do the existing `DockProjectionReconciler.spec.mjs` pins, including the retained root tab and the rejected-flight phases. |
| AC-4 | The unit pin `a nesting commit whose swap flight fails keeps the staged split, which holds the root tab`: recovery is `completed-swap`, one visible shell remains, and it holds the live root tab. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. In `settleFailedProjection`, an old shell that is no longer the host's child counts as nested, so the staged shell survives with it.

## Test Evidence
- **Red on `dev` 4f71641ec3, green here:** the two component arms fail on `dev`: the nested root tab is invisible, and the collapsed host holds two shells. The three unit pins fail too (`unrecoverable`, hidden, two shells). All five pass here.
- **Regression:** `test/playwright/component/dashboard/` passes 140/140; `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/` passes 1286, skipping 2; the full unit tier passes 4906, skipping 2; `WorkstationCommitContinuity` passes.
